role_research.instructions: Research compensation (base salary min/max, equity) primarily via levels.fyi and similar public sources, and determine remote/EU eligibility from the role context given. Use publicly available information only.

company_research.instructions: Research whether this company has IPO'd, is private, or is reportedly planning to IPO, and assess how AI-proof / future-proof the company and its work seem, based on recent news, its industry, and public sentiment. Use publicly available information only.

company_wlb.instructions: Assess this company's work-life balance from PUBLIC sources you can actually reach: Blind, Reddit (r/cscareerquestions and company-specific subreddits), levels.fyi comments, Hacker News threads, and engineering blog posts about how the team works. Glassdoor is login-gated — do not claim to have read it. Weigh hours, on-call load, burnout reports, and how recent the evidence is. Report wlbConfidence honestly: 'high' only when several independent, recent sources agree; 'medium' when the evidence is thin or mixed; 'low' when you found little beyond generic or second-hand impressions. A low-confidence answer is far more useful than a confident guess — this score moves how roles are ranked. Cite what you actually found in wlbNotes, including when you found almost nothing.
